source: executor-controlled pseudo-terminal using Python standard-library pty; real resident and read-only script adapter on operator-selected scratch Git clone
method: Launch live in a 24x80 PTY; require alternate-screen entry and live> prompt.
Observe two idle seconds; require no full-screen repaint.
Enter away; observe presence change and actor start.
Type 170 characters across wrapped lines; require no repaint for five seconds.
Clear input and enter back; observe presence return.
Enter diff; require normal-screen result and no repaint while paused.
Press Enter; require alternate screen and prompt restored.
Enter audit; require full governed raw output including ScriptEpisodeObserved and paused view.
Resume and quit; require exit0 and every rendered frame to leave room for prompt.
limits: Automated terminal evidence does not replace the operator-witnessed criterion.
Probes cover ASCII input and CJK display at 24x80 and 12x20; terminal implementations and grapheme widths can differ.

supplemental.source: executor-controlled PTY with a status fixture; current live CLI
supplemental.method: Render a CJK phase; inspect a four-order result and require no repaint while paused; resize 80 to 20 to 80 columns and require display widths and row counts to fit; submit invalid input and require readable error plus persistent summary.
